name: lantide-data-plugin
description: Connect Codex to Lantide Data for safe setup, local-first data workflows, and reviewable plans, evidence, and reports.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex to reviewable local data workflows.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Lantide Data and turn local CSV, Excel, Parquet, and database work into reviewable analysis. Get guided installation, user-approved local MCP pairing, safe troubleshooting, and a structured path from question to plan, evidence, and report. This skills-only companion does not read files or receive credentials by itself; live tools and data access come from Lantide Data Desktop under the scope you approve.
defaultPrompt: Connect Codex to my installed Lantide Data app and verify the local MCP connection.
Help me turn a folder of weekly CSV exports into a reusable Lantide analysis with a reviewable plan and validation checks.
Lantide Data is installed, but Codex cannot see its tools. Diagnose the connection without exposing credentials.
